summary: Of 24 key details Brendan Dassey stated or agreed to across three recorded sessions, investigators introduced 8 first (one only in part), 4 were already public, 1 may trace to an earlier non-public statement, and 11 appear first in the record from Dassey. In the 8 investigator-first details, Dassey adopted each by agreeing to a question. For "shot inside the garage," investigators named "shot" (p. 597) and Dassey supplied "garage" (p. 597). Four details (body burned behind garage, license plates removed, vehicle key in bedroom, clothes burned) were publicly reported November 2005, before any interview. One detail (bleach on jeans) appears in a non-public statement to Fassbender (Decision and Order p. 7) before its transcript debut (p. 527). Eleven details have no earlier transcript source. One detail (tattoo on stomach) was raised by investigators (p. 662) but never adopted.
key_points: Investigators introduced 8 key details first; Dassey adopted each by agreeing to a question: vehicle in Avery's garage (p. 548), knife (p. 460/463), shot in head (p. 587), tires and branches on fire (p. 454), license plates removed (p. 601/602), Avery raised hood (p. 603), blood on garage floor (p. 547/609), phone/camera/purse burned in barrel (p. 817/835).

Four details were publicly reported before any interview; investigators also mentioned them before Dassey: body burned behind garage (public Nov 16, 2005; investigators p. 442), license plates removed (public Nov 16, 2005; investigators p. 601), vehicle key in bedroom (public Nov 10, 2005), clothes burned (public Nov 16, 2005; investigators p. 456).

One detail may trace to an earlier non-public statement: bleach on jeans described to Fassbender evening of Feb 27, 2006 (Decision and Order p. 7, citing ECF 19-19 at 10-11); first appears in transcript at Mar 1, 2006, p. 527.

Eleven details appear first in the record from Dassey with no earlier transcript source: tied with rope (p. 471), body in RAV4 (p. 550), restrained on bed (p. 566), stabbed in stomach (p. 469), strangled until unconscious (p. 579), hair cut (p. 584), throat cut (p. 586), shot with .22 rifle (p. 587), RAV4 hidden in salvage yard (p. 459), bedsheets burned (p. 607), bones broken with shovel (p. 637).

For "shot inside garage," investigators named "shot" (p. 597) and Dassey named "garage" (p. 597) in the same exchange; counted as investigator-first because they named part before he completed the detail.
One detail (tattoo on stomach) was raised by investigators (p. 662) but Dassey never stated or agreed to it.
limits: This audit only tracks who said what first in the available transcripts; it cannot assess truthfulness, reliability, or voluntariness of any statement.
Two sessions (S1b at Two Rivers PD and S1c with Fassbender) have no public transcript; contamination from those sessions cannot be ruled out for details first appearing later.
Public reporting dates are noted, but the audit cannot determine whether public information originated from investigation leaks or independent sources.
The audit documents question tactics (e.g., "we already know," minimization, demand truth) but does not measure their psychological effect on suggestibility or compliance.
